name: MX2D_Q5D-WV3.28-20250619
body:
Original Timmkoo Q5 software **MX2D_Q5D-WV3.28-20250619**.

- Model: **Q5** (Timmkoo)
- Package: `rom_q5.zip`
- Build tag: `MX2D_Q5D-WV3.28-20250619`
- Build date: 2025-06-19

## Install

1. Download `rom_q5.zip` (every numbered volume if the release has more than one, then `cat rom_q5.zip.* > rom_q5.zip`).
2. Unzip it. Keep the scatter file next to the images.
3. Open SP Flash Tool, choose **Download Only**, load the scatter file from the archive and flash.
4. Or use Innioasis Updater CE: <https://innioasis.app/guide.html>

This wipes the player. Back up music and recordings first.
